description_en: Modifies an automatic bypass single-stream relay rule by calling UpdateAutoLiveStreamRule
description_zh: 调用UpdateAutoLiveStreamRule修改自动旁路单路转推规则
kebab_example: aliyun rtc update-auto-live-stream-rule --app-id eo850000 --play-domain rtmp://_domain_/_app_/_stream --rule-id 12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAutoLiveStreamRule

parameters.help_en: The list of channel IDs for exact matching
parameters.name: channel_ids

parameters.help_en: The prefix list for fuzzy matching of channel IDs
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配频道ID的前缀列表
parameters.name: channel_id_prefixes

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query applications in the console
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可通过控制台创建和查询
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain name for automatic bypass. The streaming URL for an automatic bypass task is rtmp://${domain}/${app}/${stream}.

domain: Your live streaming domain name.
app: live.
stream: urlencode(${AppId}${ChannelId}${UserId}_${SourceType}), where SourceType is the input source type
parameters.help_zh:
自动旁路的播流域名。自动旁路任务对应播流地址为rtmp://${domain}/${app}/${stream}。

domain: 您的直播播流域名。
app: live。
stream: urlencode(${AppId}${ChannelId}${UserId}_${SourceType})，其中SourceType为输入源类型
parameters.name: play_domain

parameters.help_en: The name of the bypass rule
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The callback URL for starting and stopping bypass tasks. You can query the callback URL in the console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353198.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 开启和结束旁路的回调地址。您可以通过控制台查询或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353198.html获取旁路回调地址
parameters.name: call_back

parameters.help_en: The encoding option. For more information, see the MediaEncode enumeration values in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353179.html
parameters.help_zh: 编码选项。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353179.html中MediaEncode枚举值
parameters.name: media_encode

parameters.help_en: The bypass rule ID. You can query the rule ID in the console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353198.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 旁路规则ID。您可以通过控制台查询或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353198.html获取旁路规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id
